SEO and digital marketing for businesses across the U.S.

SEO GUARANTEE FEATURED ON

The short answer

### What is a guaranteed SEO company?

It is an SEO company that ties its work to the first page of Google with a promise you can check. Ours is the sentence under our headline: a share of the key phrases you could rank for, reaching page one on the schedule set out below. We agree it only after an assessment of your business and your market, because a promise made before anyone has looked is only a slogan. See in Step 1 whether you qualify.

The map, Google and AI answers

### Three places a customer finds you, one first page guarantee

Your customers look in three places before they pick a business, and you need to be in each. This is the work behind all three; answer Step 1 and we will show you where you stand in each one today.

#### Your Business Profile on the map

Search for a service nearby and Google puts a small map above everything else, with a few businesses pinned on it. We fill in your Business Profile, set your service area and help you collect reviews, so your pin can be one of them.

#### Your website on page one

People who scroll past the map choose from the websites listed below it. We write a page for each service you sell, in the words your customers use, and work every one of those pages toward page one.

#### The businesses AI assistants suggest

More people now ask an AI assistant who to hire. It can only suggest a business it understands, so we describe your services, hours and service area the same way on your site and on every listing.

We build a list of every variation your customers could type to find a business like yours, and we go after all of them.

- 20% on the first page within 90 days

- 40% on the first page within 180 days

- 50%+ on the first page within the first year

### Questions about hiring an SEO agency or firm

Still deciding?

Tell us your trade and town in Step 1; our answer names the searches worth winning first.

#### What does a guaranteed SEO company actually do for my business?

It works to put your business on the first page wherever your customers look: your Business Profile on the map, your pages in the regular results and the answers AI assistants give. Ours puts a promise you can check behind that work, agreed after an assessment, so you know what you are paying for.

#### Do you do digital marketing, or only SEO?

Both, with search at the center, because it reaches people at the moment they are looking. Our first page guarantee is about rankings, never a promise of sales; the profile, review and website work around it, including the design and conversion work in our Full Suite, is what turns a visit into a customer.

#### Can you help a business in any state?

Yes. Every plan starts from your own market, so we look at who holds the first page for your searches where you are before we suggest anything. Tell us your town and your trade in Step 1.

#### How soon should I expect to see progress?

The schedule shown with the three guarantee cards above sets the dates we measure your first page rankings against, from the first milestone to the end of the first year. Between those dates you see the work as it happens: new pages, a fuller profile and the searches that start to move.

#### What happens after I answer Step 1?

We reply the same business day and ask about your business, your customers and the places you serve. After an assessment we tell you whether you qualify for the first page guarantee and which searches we would go after first.

#### Why should I believe an SEO agency's promise?

Do not take it on trust. Look at the cards on this page, each a business we have worked for on page one of Google, read what clients wrote about us in their own words, then put every question you have to us in writing.

# The SEO Guarantee: What Is Guaranteed, and What Is Not

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/first-page-seo-guarantee/

Is guaranteed SEO real?

It is, when a first page promise names what it counts and by when. Ours names the three places you can show up, a share of the key phrases you could rank for and the dates we measure against, and we agree it only after an assessment of your business.

We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google.

SEO GUARANTEE FEATURED ON

In plain words

### What is an SEO guarantee?

An SEO guarantee is a promise about rankings on the first page of Google that you can check against dates. Ours is the sentence right under our headline, and the schedule further down this page shows when each share of your key phrases is due. We agree it after an assessment of your business, and it is about rankings, never a promise of sales. Find out in Step 1 whether your business qualifies.

Three places, one promise

### Where the first page guarantee applies

You need to be seen wherever a customer looks, not in just one of these places. Here is how we work each of them; start Step 1 and we will measure all three for your business.

#### The map, for customers close by

When someone needs a service near them, Google shows a map before any website. We build out your Business Profile with the right categories, photos and service area, and help you gather reviews, so yours can be one of the few on it.

#### Regular results, one page per service

Customers comparing their options scroll down to the websites under the map. We give every service you want to sell a page of its own, written the way customers ask for it, so each one can climb toward page one.

#### AI answers that can name you

Someone who asks an AI assistant for a recommendation gets the businesses it can read clearly. We make your services, opening hours and area read the same on your website and your listings, so it has what it needs to name yours.

We build a list of every variation your customers could type to find a business like yours, and we go after all of them.

- 20% on the first page within 90 days

- 40% on the first page within 180 days

- 50%+ on the first page within the first year

The honest answer

### Is guaranteed SEO real? The first page promise we make, and the one no one can

You are right to be wary of any promise about Google. Google decides the order of its own results, and it says itself that no one can promise a particular place in them. So we never promise you a position, and never sales or calls. What we do promise is narrower, and you can check it: a share of the key phrases you could rank for, on the first page, by dated milestones.

Three habits keep that promise honest. We look before we promise: the first page guarantee comes after an assessment of your business and of the searches in your market. We measure where your customers really look: your Business Profile on the map, the regular results and the answers AI assistants give. And we work from the full list of ways your customers could search for you, which we build with you at the start.

That is also why we tell you plainly when the first page is out of reach for now, and what would have to change first. Answer Step 1, and after the assessment you will know which it is for your business.

What we never promise

- A particular spot Google sets its own order and changes it, so we never name a place in it.

- Sales or calls Our promise is about where you rank; what happens after the click depends on your offer.

- Dates faster than the schedule We measure against the schedule set out above, nothing sooner.

Guarantee or pay-for-performance

### Pay-for-performance SEO or a first page guarantee?

You may have been offered pay-for-performance SEO. It is a way of pricing the work: what you pay moves with what gets measured. A first page guarantee is a promise about the result itself, which with us means a share of the key phrases you could rank for, on the first page of Google, by set dates.

Whichever you choose, ask three questions before you sign: which searches count, where they are counted, and who chose them. Our answers start from the full list of ways your customers could search for you, which we build with you, and we track where each of those searches shows your business: on the map, in the regular results and in AI answers. Start with Step 1 and we will show you that list for your own business.

How our fee works is something we set out in our reply, once we have seen your market.

Questions worth asking before you sign

- Which searches count? The full list your customers use, or a short list picked for you?

- Where are they counted? The map, the regular results and AI answers are three different places.

- When is it measured? A schedule with dates you can check, set before the work starts.

Your price

### What sets the price of guaranteed SEO

Your price follows the size of the job it takes to reach the first page in your market, so we do not quote it before we have looked. One service in one town needs a handful of pages; many services across several cities need many more, and a crowded trade takes longer than a quiet one. Begin with Step 1 and we will price the work in our reply.

What moves the price

- Services and places Each service in each town you serve gets a page of its own.

- Your competition The more crowded your searches, the more work the first page takes.

- Repairs first A slow site or an empty profile is fixed before new pages go up.

### Questions about SEO guarantees

Still deciding?

Tell us your trade in Step 1, and we will say whether the first page is within reach.

#### Is guaranteed SEO real, or a sales line?

It is real when a first page promise names what is measured and when. Ours puts a share of the key phrases you could rank for on page one of Google by dated milestones, agreed after an assessment, and it never promises sales.

#### Can you promise my business a particular spot on Google?

No. Google sets its own order and changes it, and it says itself that no one can promise a particular place in its results. What we can promise is a share of your key phrases on the first page, where your customers make their choice.

#### Do I have to qualify for the guarantee?

Yes. We assess your business, your website and the searches in your market first, then tell you plainly whether the first page is within reach now or what has to change before it is.

#### Do I still need SEO if I already pay for ads?

Ads rent you a place for as long as you pay for each click. Pages that rank keep showing up between campaigns and reach people who skip the ads. We go through your ads in our reply and show you where search could take over from paid clicks.

#### What happens once I answer Step 1?

Someone from our team replies the same business day. After an assessment of your business and your market, we tell you whether you qualify, which searches we would start with and what the work would cost.

# First Page SEO Guarantee Terms

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/first-page-seo-guarantee/terms/

Written guarantee terms

We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google.

Last updated September 29, 2026

What we promise about where your business shows up on Google, how we measure it and what happens if we fall short, in plain words.

### What these terms are

These terms set out our first page guarantee: the promise we make about where your business shows up on Google, how we measure it and what happens if we fall short. They are part of every client agreement that includes the first page guarantee. If your signed agreement says something different on a point, your signed agreement decides that point.

In these terms, we and us mean First Page SEO Guarantee, and you means the business that signs the agreement.

### The promise in one line

The sentence at the top of this page is our first page guarantee: a portion of the key phrases your business could rank for, reaching the first page of Google by set dates after your plan starts, in each of the three places your customers look on Google. The rest of these terms explain each part of that sentence.

### Who qualifies

The first page guarantee is offered after an assessment, and only if you qualify. Before we sign, we look at your business, your website, your Google Business Profile, the searches your customers make and the businesses that already show up for them. We then tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

To qualify:

- you run a real business that serves customers in the market we agree on, and you can legally advertise what you sell there;

- you own or control your website and your Google Business Profile, or can give us the access we need to work on them;

- your website and profile are not under a penalty or suspension from Google that cannot be fixed as part of your plan;

- you agree to the key phrase list and the start date described below.

### Your key phrase list

We build a list of every variation your customers could type to find a business like yours, and we go after all of them. At the start we agree the list with you in writing. It is the list the first page guarantee is measured against, and it stays the same for the whole term unless we both agree in writing to change it.

A few rules keep the count fair:

- searches for your own business name do not count, because you should show up for those already;

- each phrase counts once in each place, even when more than one of your pages shows up for it there;

- a phrase for a service you stop offering, or a place you stop serving, comes off the list, and each share is worked out from the phrases that remain;

- if Google stops showing a results page for a phrase the way it does today, we replace it with the closest phrase we both agree on.

### What counts as the first page, in each place

We measure the first page guarantee separately in each of the three places your customers look on Google. A key phrase counts in a place when a search for it on Google, made from the market we agreed, shows your business there:

- the map results: the local map results, through your Google Business Profile;

- the organic results: the first page of the regular results, meaning the first ten organic results;

- AI answers: the answer written by AI that Google shows on the results page, when it names or links your business.

### The schedule

We work out your share separately for each place. In the map results and in the organic results, your share is the number of phrases on your list that count there, divided by the number of phrases on your list. Google does not show an AI answer for every search, so in AI answers your share is the number of phrases that count there, divided by the number of phrases on your list for which Google shows an AI answer when we check. If Google shows an AI answer for none of them at a check, there is no share to measure in AI answers at that check, and that milestone is judged in the map results and the organic results.

The first page guarantee is measured on three dates, counted from your start date, and each milestone must be reached separately in the map results, in the organic results and in AI answers:

- by day 90: at least 20% on the first page, in each of the three places;

- by day 180: at least 40% on the first page, in each of the three places;

- by the end of the first year: 50%+ on the first page, in each of the three places.

### Your start date

The first page guarantee tops out at the last of those three milestones. Our aim is always more, and we keep working toward every phrase on your list, but the promise itself is the three dates above.

Your start date is the day we begin work under your signed agreement, once we have the access listed under your part below. We confirm it to you in writing.

### How we check

On each milestone date we search every phrase on your list from the market we agreed. For each phrase we record whether your business shows up in the map results, in the organic results and in an AI answer, and whether Google showed an AI answer at all, and we send you the results with your share in each of the three places. You can ask for the same report at any time between milestones, and we run it within ten days of your request.

Google's results can differ a little from one searcher to the next. If you see something different from our report, tell us and we will check it again with you.

### If a milestone is missed

If a milestone date passes and your share in one or more of the three places is below that milestone, we keep doing the work in your plan and stop billing you for it until your share in each place reaches that milestone. Billing starts again from the day our check shows the milestone reached in each place, and the next milestone date moves back by the same number of days.

This is the remedy under the first page guarantee. It does not change the fees for work already done, and it does not apply to a milestone missed for one of the reasons listed below, under when the first page guarantee does not apply.

### Your part

The first page guarantee depends on us being able to do the work. For as long as it runs, you agree to:

- give us access to your website, your Google Business Profile and any analytics account within ten days of signing, and keep that access in place;

- answer our questions, and approve or correct new pages and profile changes, within ten days of our request;

- tell us before you, or anyone else, changes your website, domain, business name, address, phone number or profile;

- not hire another company to work on the SEO of the same website while the first page guarantee runs, unless we agree to it in writing;

- keep your account paid up to date.

### When the first page guarantee does not apply

The first page guarantee does not apply to a milestone missed because:

- your website, domain or Business Profile was down, suspended or penalized for a reason outside our work;

- you, or someone other than us, changed or removed pages, links, settings or listings we set up;

- you changed your business name, address, service area or services after the list was agreed, and did not agree an updated list with us;

- a payment was more than 30 days late, or you paused the work;

- a law, a court order or an event outside anyone's control, such as a natural disaster, stopped the work.

### Changes Google makes

Google's regular changes to how it ranks pages are not on that list. Keeping up with them is part of the work, and they do not excuse a missed milestone under the first page guarantee.

### What the first page guarantee does not promise

It is a promise about where your business shows up on Google, and nothing else. It does not promise:

- any particular position on the page;

- more traffic, calls, leads, customers or sales;

- results on search engines other than Google;

- any first page share above the three milestones;

- results for phrases that are not on your agreed list.

### How long it runs, and ending the agreement

The first page guarantee runs from your start date to the end of the first year, when the last milestone falls, plus any days added under these terms. After that, your plan continues only if we both agree to continue it.

Either of us can end the agreement by giving the other 30 days' notice in writing. If you end it before a milestone date, the first page guarantee ends with it, and the milestones still to come no longer apply. Fees for work already done stay due.

### Fees and billing

Your fees, billing dates and payment method are set out in your agreement, which we send you before any work begins. If a payment is late, we may pause the work after telling you in writing; the days the work is paused are added to the milestone dates.

### Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time and will show the date of the change at the top of them. The version in place when you sign your agreement is the one that applies to it, unless we both agree in writing to use a newer one.

### Governing law

These terms and your agreement are governed by the laws of the State of Nevada. If we disagree about them, we will first try to settle it by talking it through. If that does not work, either of us may take the matter to the state or federal courts in Clark County, Nevada.

### Questions

Ask us anything about these terms before you sign, through the form on our contact page. Our privacy policy explains how we handle the details you send us.

# Guaranteed SEO packages: rank, build and convert under one house

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/services/suite/

The Full Suite

Pick a service below, or start with the free SEO audit.

One team

### Why one team beats a rented stack of vendors

Many local businesses assemble their marketing from parts: an SEO agency, a web designer, a freelance writer and, if they are lucky, someone who looks at conversions. That means several contracts, several logins and several reports, each telling a different story. When rankings slip, the SEO blames the website, the web designer blames the content, and nobody owns the result.

The Full Suite is the other way to do it. No more needing to have multiple people, companies, freelancers or agencies: you get everything under one house, without any outsourcing. The team that measures your competitors is the team that builds your pages, writes your content, works your Business Profile and tests your conversions, so a change the measurement calls for ships without a hand-off.

It also means one team answers for page one. The first page guarantee is measured in three places, and every service on this page is part of the plan behind it. There is no other vendor to point at.

### The problem: page two is where customers stop looking

A customer who needs you types a few words into Google and picks from what the first page shows. The clicks gather at the top. In Advanced Web Ranking's study of US desktop results for July 2026, the first organic result had an average click-through rate of 20.02%, the second 10.36% and the third 3.89%, and the first three together took roughly 92% of the clicks that reached the top ten.

Past page one, the clicks nearly stop. In Backlinko's data (revised 2022), only 0.63% of Google searchers clicked anything on the second page. Sistrix measured under 1% for every result on page two.

Page one does not arrive on its own, either. Ahrefs followed a million random new pages and found that only 1.74% reached the top ten within a year. And the page is crowded: Advanced Web Ranking found AI Overviews, the AI answers Google shows above the results, on 43% of sampled desktop results pages in July 2026, and where one appeared, the first organic result's click rate fell by 52%.

Nobody can buy their way into these results. Google says it "never accepts money to include or rank sites in our search results". Page one is earned, page by page and phrase by phrase, and a business that is not there is handing those customers to the competitors who are.

Start here

The work starts with the free SEO audit. Enter your website and your email on the free SEO audit page, and that request is where the work begins.

What comes after is the method, and it is the same for every client. We build your phrase list, then pull every business and page that already holds a page-one slot for each phrase, in each place Google shows for it: the map results, the organic results and the AI answer. We measure what they have, then plan the work to match all of it and do more.

Google's own guide to hiring an SEO tells owners to ask: "What kind of results do you expect to see, and in what timeframe? How do you measure your success?" It also says a good SEO asks who your competitors are. The measurement is how we answer both. Before we sign, we tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

In the plan

### SEO services in the plan

These are the SEO services the plan carries. Each one is aimed at the same number: your share of the phrase list on page one.

#### Keyword strategy and your phrase list

We build a list of every variation your customers could type to find a business like yours, and we go after all of them. The list comes from your services, the words people add to them ("near me", "cost", "emergency", "open now") and the places you serve, checked against Google's own search data, which is rounded and set by location. Searches for your own business name do not count.

What you get: a written phrase list, agreed with you at the start, that the first page guarantee is measured against.

#### On-page SEO

Google's advice is plain: use the words people search with, and put them in prominent places such as the title and the main heading. We give every service you sell a page of its own, because in Whitespark's 2026 survey of 47 local search experts, a dedicated page for each service led the list of local organic ranking factors.

What you get: on page SEO services across every page that should rank, from titles, headings and internal links to structured data that matches what the page says.

#### Technical SEO

Google Search works in three stages, crawling, indexing and serving results, and not every page makes it through all three. Technical SEO keeps your pages moving through them: a clean site structure, working redirects, templates measured for speed and no pages blocked by mistake. Google uses Core Web Vitals in ranking and rates a page good when its main content loads within 2.5 seconds, it responds to input in under 200 milliseconds and its layout shift stays under 0.1.

What you get: technical SEO services that keep Google able to crawl, index and serve your pages, with speed measured against those thresholds.

#### Content that covers what page one covers

Google's starter guide says content people find compelling and useful will likely influence your presence in search more than any of its other suggestions. So for each phrase we list the topics the page-one pages cover, find the ones your page misses, and add what they lack: first-hand detail, clear answers and your own photos.

What you get: new and rewritten pages that match the depth of page one and go past it, written by our writers and editors.

#### Link building

Google uses links to find pages and to judge how relevant they are, and it says PageRank is still part of its core ranking systems. Ahrefs' rule of thumb for the top ten is to acquire as many links as the pages already there, if not more, which is our method in one line.

What you get: a list of the sites that link to the pages ahead of you and not to yours, worked down with links from relevant businesses, local organizations and publications.

#### A report on each milestone

On each milestone date we search every phrase on your list from the market we agreed, record where your business shows up in each of the three places, and send you the results. You can ask for the same report at any time between milestones, and we run it within ten days.

What you get: your share in the map results, the organic results and the AI answers, counted phrase by phrase and never blended into one score.

How we do it

### How we measure the gap

This is the method. It is arithmetic over measurements, not a promise of any one ranking, and Google still decides the outcome.

For each phrase on your list we search Google from your agreed market, because Google says its results depend on the searcher's location and settings. We record what shows: the map results, the ten organic results and, when Google shows one, the AI answer. Then we measure the businesses and pages already there:

- Content: the topics, depth and format of each ranking page, against yours.

- On-page: titles, headings, internal links and structured data.

- Links: how many sites link to each ranking page, an input Ahrefs and Semrush build their keyword difficulty scores from.

- Business Profile: the categories, the review count, rating and pace of new reviews, the photos and the citations of the businesses in the map results.

- AI answer: whether one appears, and which pages and businesses it names or links.

Every one of those inputs comes from outside Google. Google says third-party tools have no access to its internal ranking data, and Ahrefs, which sells one of those tools, says no difficulty metric can accurately predict your chances of ranking. So we treat each score as an estimate and study the pages behind it.

The gap is the distance between you and the weakest business still holding a page-one slot in each place. That is the business you have to pass first, not the leader.

How we do it

### How we close it

Once the gaps are measured, the plan is an order of work. Phrases with the smallest gaps go first, then the harder ones, so your share of page one builds in waves toward each milestone. The schedule in the written terms is at least 20% of your list on the first page by day 90, 40% by day 180 and 50%+ by the end of the first year, with each share measured separately in each of the three places.

We win phrases with useful pages and strong links. Google makes broad core updates several times a year; the written terms say those changes do not excuse a missed milestone, and keeping up with them is part of the work.

What we will not promise is a position. Google's own advice on hiring an SEO is blunt:

“No one can guarantee a #1 ranking on Google.”

Google Search Central, “Do you need an SEO?”

We agree. The first page guarantee names no position and is never every phrase on your list. It is a share of the list on page one, by set dates, in each place.

### Frequently asked questions

#### What do small business SEO services include?

At First Page SEO Guarantee, they include a keyword strategy built on an agreed phrase list, on-page and technical SEO, content that covers what the page-one results cover, links from relevant sites, and a report on each milestone date. Everything is measured against the businesses already on page one for each phrase. SEO sits inside the Full Suite, so web design, content writing, local SEO, AI search optimization and conversion work come from the same team.

#### How long does SEO take to show results?

Google's current guidance says some changes take effect in a few hours and others take several months, and suggests waiting a few weeks before judging. Ahrefs found that 40.82% of the pages that reached the top ten did so within a month. Our written terms set the milestones: at least 20% of your phrase list on the first page by day 90, 40% by day 180 and 50%+ by the end of the first year, in each of the three places separately.

#### Can an SEO company guarantee first page rankings?

Not for every phrase, and never for a particular position: Google's own hiring advice says no one can promise the top ranking. Our guaranteed small business SEO is narrower and written down. After an assessment, we guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, by set dates, measured separately in each of the three places. The written terms set out how each share is checked.

#### What is technical SEO, and is it part of the plan?

Technical SEO is the work that lets Google crawl, index and show your pages: site structure, redirects, speed, mobile layout and markup. It is part of the SEO work in the plan, and because the same team builds and maintains websites, the fixes ship on your site without a hand-off to another vendor. Google uses Core Web Vitals in ranking, but it says good scores alone do not decide who ranks at the top, so speed work always sits beside content and links.

#### Do I still need SEO if I run paid ads?

Paid ads and organic results are separate. Google says it never accepts money to include or rank sites in its organic results, so an ad budget buys clicks only while it runs. Organic rankings are earned, and they do not switch off when a budget does, though Google says no position is fixed in place. One client, Liquor License Agents, moved from heavy spending on paid advertising to our SEO service, as its case page describes.

#### How do you measure SEO results?

We count phrases. On each milestone date we search every phrase on your agreed list from your market and record whether your business shows up in the map results, the organic results and Google's AI answer. Your share in each place is the phrases that count there divided by the phrases on the list; in AI answers it is counted over the phrases for which Google shows one. It is a plain count, not a click-weighted share of voice.

# A local SEO agency with a guarantee in Google's map results

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/services/local-seo/

Local SEO

We are a local SEO agency with a guarantee for your Google Business Profile in Google's local map results: after an assessment, we guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will show your profile there, on a set schedule. We build out the profile, its categories, the local pages and the citations behind it, measured against the businesses already in the map results. It is one of the three places the first page guarantee measures, beside the organic results and Google's AI answers.

The guarantee

We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, measured separately in each of the three places, after an assessment of your business. See how the first page guarantee is measured.

- Map results

- Organic results

- AI answers

### The problem: the map results decide who gets the call

Search for a service and Google answers with a map and a short list of businesses, often before any website. It does this even when nobody types a place: Google says your location "helps to show you nearby results" even when the search leaves the place out. When we checked 12 commercial local searches from one U.S. city on September 27, 2026, the map results showed on 11 of them.

If your Business Profile is not in that short list, the call, the visit and the directions request go to a business that is. Google Maps alone has more than 2 billion users a month, by Google's February 2025 count, and Google is plain that nobody can buy a better spot: "There's no way to request or pay for a better local ranking on Google."

The unpaid map listings are also getting squeezed. Sterling Sky's State of Local SEO report for 2026 found ads in the local pack on almost 22% of its reports, up from 1%, and Local Services Ads on 31% of the queries it tracked, up from roughly 11%, as paid placements grew through 2025. Every paid slot is one less look at the listings you earn.

Start here

### Start with the free SEO audit

The free SEO audit is where the work starts. Enter your website and your email on the free SEO audit page, and we take it from there.

After that comes the method. For each phrase on your list we search Google from your agreed market and record every business in the map results. Then we measure what they have: their primary and additional categories, how far they sit from the search point, their review count, rating and pace of new reviews, their photos, hours and listed services, their citations and the pages their profiles link to. That measurement shows what your profile has to match, then beat, phrase by phrase. Before we sign, we tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

In the plan

### Local SEO services in the plan

These are the local search engine optimization services the plan carries, each aimed at one number: your share of the phrase list in the map results.

#### Business Profile categories and setup

Google says the categories you select affect your local ranking, and a profile can carry one primary category plus up to nine more. We set your categories from what the profiles ahead of you use.

What you get: Google Business Profile management that starts with the right primary category and the additional ones the measurement points to, the field that led Whitespark's 2026 list of local pack factors.

#### Address and service area

Service-area businesses hide their address and can list up to 20 service areas, within about two hours' drive of where they are based.

What you get: your address and service areas set up on your profile.

#### Services, hours and photos

Google says a service you list may be highlighted on your profile when customers search for it. Hours must be your real customer-facing hours, and Google's photo rules ask for pictures that represent reality, with no heavy filters or AI edits.

What you get: services listed the way customers search for them, hours that match your door and photos of your real business.

#### Review requests and replies

Google allows asking customers for honest reviews, for example with a link or a QR code, and bans paid reviews, incentives and asking only the happy customers. In BrightLocal's 2026 survey of 1,002 US consumers, 89% expect business owners to respond to reviews, and generic or templated replies put off 50% of consumers.

What you get: a simple way to ask each customer for a review, and a reply to every review.

#### Local pages on your website

In Whitespark's 2026 survey, a dedicated page for each service led the local organic factors and placed in the map pack and AI visibility lists as well, and a name, address and phone on your site that match your profile is a map factor too. Our website team builds those pages as part of the same plan.

What you get: a page for each service and area you want to be found for, with details that match your profile.

#### Citations and directory listings

Whitespark's experts weight citations at 6% of the map pack, a small share, but they call three of the top five AI search visibility factors citation factors. Consistent listings on Google Maps, Bing Maps and Apple Maps are the citation factor they rate highest for the map pack.

What you get: your business name, address, phone and hours kept the same across the listings that matter, including Apple Maps and Bing Places.

#### Map results tracking on each milestone

On each milestone date we search every phrase on your list from the market we agreed and record whether your profile shows in the map results.

What you get: your map share on each milestone date, next to the search terms your own Business Profile Performance report shows, which Google updates monthly.

How we do it

### What decides the map results

Google's own help page says local results are "mainly based on relevance, distance, and popularity", and explains the third factor under the heading "Prominence".

- Relevance is how well your profile matches what someone searched for. Categories, services and the words on your pages drive it.

- Distance is measured from the searcher, and Google estimates the location when the searcher does not share it. You cannot move your business, so distance is the factor nobody can work on.

- Prominence is how well-known the business is. Google says it draws on how many websites link to you and how many reviews you have, and that more reviews and positive ratings can help your local ranking.

Whitespark's 2026 survey of 47 local search experts puts rough weights on the map pack: Business Profile signals 32%, reviews 20%, on-page signals 15%, links 8% and citations 6%. It is an expert-opinion survey, not a measurement of Google, and its authors say none of the experts has special access to Google's algorithm. Its top two factors are the primary category and the searcher's distance from the address.

Reviews matter because Google says so. Sterling Sky's study of 8,186 businesses in 200 cities found that the reviews a business got that month mattered more for "near me" rankings than its total count. Reviews come from your customers; our measurement counts the review count, rating and pace of every business ahead of you, so the gap is on paper.

How we do it

### How we work your Business Profile

The order matters. First the address and hours: Google says a virtual office or P.O. box is not eligible, and hours must match the door. Then the categories, then services, photos and attributes, then the local pages and citations behind them. Google warns that editing a category can trigger a new verification.

The profile also feeds Google's AI now. Google shut down the Business Profile Q&A API on November 3, 2025, and is moving customer questions to AI answers in Google Maps. Ask Maps, a Gemini feature inside Google Maps, launched in the U.S. and India on March 12, 2026. Ask Maps and the AI answers in Google Maps do not count toward the first page guarantee, which counts the AI answer on Google's results page. Google also lists an up-to-date Business Profile among the fundamentals for its AI features, which is where our AI search optimization work picks up.

Questions

### Frequently asked questions

#### What does a local SEO agency do?

A local SEO agency works on the places a nearby customer finds you: your Google Business Profile in the map results and the local pages of your website. At First Page SEO Guarantee that means categories, services, hours and photos, a page for each service and area, consistent citations, and a measurement of the businesses already in the map results for each phrase on your list, checked on each milestone date.

#### How does Google decide who shows in the map results?

Google says local results are mainly based on relevance, distance and popularity, the third of which its help page explains under the heading "Prominence". Relevance is how well your profile matches the search, distance is measured from the searcher, and prominence draws on links and reviews. Google also says the categories you choose affect your local ranking, and that complete, accurate profiles are more likely to show up. Nobody can pay Google for a better local ranking.

#### How long does local SEO take?

Google's general guidance for search is that changes can take anywhere from a few hours to several months, and that it is worth waiting a few weeks before judging them. Our written terms set the milestones instead: at least 20% of your phrase list on the first page by day 90, 40% by day 180 and 50%+ by the end of the first year, measured in each of the three places separately, the map results included.

#### Can I show up in the map results in a city where I have no address?

Distance is measured from the searcher, so a business close to the search point has an edge that no one can buy. A service-area business hides its address and can list up to 20 service areas, within about two hours' drive of where it is based, but it cannot set a radius. A page on your website for each area you serve helps in the organic results, where Whitespark's experts put the city or neighborhood relevance of your content second on their list.

#### Does the first page guarantee count the map results?

Yes. The map results are one of the three places the first page guarantee measures, beside the organic results and Google's AI answers. A phrase counts in the map results when a search for it, made from your agreed market, shows your business there through your Google Business Profile. Your map share is measured separately from the other two places, and the written terms explain each check.

### See where your profile stands

The free SEO audit is the first step. Enter your website and your email, and the work starts with a measurement of the businesses already in the map results for the searches your customers make. Questions first? Contact us.

# AI SEO services with a guarantee in Google's AI answers

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/services/ai-search-optimization/

AI search (AIO / GEO)

Our AI SEO services carry a guarantee for the AI answer Google shows on its results page: after an assessment, that answer will name or link your business for up to 50% of the key phrases where Google shows one, on a set schedule. It is the third place the first page guarantee measures, beside the map and organic results, and the work behind it is SEO, because Google says optimizing for its AI features is still SEO.

The guarantee

We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, measured separately in each of the three places, after an assessment of your business. In AI answers the share is counted over the phrases where Google shows one, and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini and AI Mode are not part of it. See how the first page guarantee is measured.

- Map results

- Organic results

- AI answers

### The problem: the answer sits above the results, and it names very few

For some searches, Google writes an answer before it lists a single website. Google launched AI Overviews to everyone in the U.S. on May 14, 2024, and Alphabet reported more than 2 billion monthly users by July 2025. When the answer is there, fewer people click: in Pew Research Center's March 2025 study of 900 U.S. adults, people who saw an AI summary clicked a regular result on 8% of visits, against 15% when there was none.

Being inside the answer is what pays. Seer Interactive's 2026 update found that brands cited in an AI Overview earned 120% more organic clicks per impression than when they were not cited, though still fewer than on searches with no AI Overview at all.

Local customers are asking AI as well. BrightLocal's 2026 survey of 1,002 U.S. adults found that 45% had used AI tools for local business recommendations, up from 6% a year earlier.

The answers are uneven and selective. Google says AI Overviews "often don't trigger", and in our own check of 12 commercial local searches on September 27, 2026, Google showed one for just 2 of them. Where Google shows its AI local packs on mobile, Sterling Sky found they surface only about 32% as many businesses as the classic three-pack of map results. Few businesses get named, and the rest are left out of the answer.

Start here

### Start with the free SEO audit

The free SEO audit is where the work starts. Enter your website and your email on the free SEO audit page.

What comes after is the method. For each phrase on your list we search Google from your agreed market and record whether an AI answer shows at all. Where one does, we record which pages and businesses it names or links, and whether your own pages are indexed and eligible to be quoted. We also measure the pages and profiles already cited: what they say, which sources they give, and where else the web mentions them. That tells us what your pages, profile and listings need to become sources an AI answer can use. Before we sign, we tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

In the plan

### AI SEO services in the plan

These are the AI search optimization services the plan carries. Each one is aimed at one number: the share of your phrases where Google's AI answer names or links you.

#### Pages worth citing

Google's advice for its AI features is to make "unique, non-commodity content", and it says a unique viewpoint that stands out can help. In the peer-reviewed GEO study (KDD 2024), adding citations, quotations and statistics raised visibility by 30-40% on one metric, a lab result on a test engine rather than a promise.

What you get: service pages and answers written from your own expertise, with the sources, figures and first-hand detail an AI answer can quote.

#### A site Google can index and quote

To be a supporting link in AI Overviews or AI Mode, Google says a page must be indexed and eligible to show with a snippet, and since 2026 the site must also not be opted out of these features in Search Console. Other AI tools read your site through their own crawlers: OpenAI's OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT search, PerplexityBot for Perplexity, and Bing's index for Copilot. AI Mode and these tools do not count toward the first page guarantee.

What you get: a site that Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot can all crawl, with no setting that keeps your pages out of an answer by mistake.

#### A Business Profile and listings that agree

Google says its generative AI responses can include information about local businesses, and that Business Profiles can help your services show in AI responses. Microsoft points local businesses to Bing Places, and Google's Gemini app answers place questions from Google Maps data. The Gemini app does not count toward the first page guarantee.

What you get: your Google Business Profile, your Bing Places listing and your key directory listings saying the same thing as your website, handled with our local SEO work.

#### Mentions on sites the answers trust

In an Ahrefs study of 75K brands, web mentions correlated with AI Overview visibility at 0.664, against 0.218 for backlinks, a correlation rather than proof. Whitespark's experts put a business's presence on expert-curated "best of" lists first among AI visibility factors, and Google warns that inauthentic mentions are not as helpful as they might seem.

What you get: mentions of your business on relevant sites, industry associations and local publications.

#### AI answer tracking on each milestone

On each milestone date we search every phrase on your list from the market we agreed, record whether Google showed an AI answer, and whether it named or linked your business.

What you get: your AI share on each milestone date, counted over the phrases where Google showed an AI answer, next to the impressions Search Console's generative AI report shows for your site.

How we do it

### How Google picks the sources for an AI answer

Google's documentation is clear that there is no separate system to game: "The best practices for SEO continue to be relevant because our generative AI features on Google Search are rooted in our core Search ranking and quality systems." Its AI features can run a "query fan-out", issuing several related searches across subtopics, which lets them link a wider and more varied set of pages than a classic results page.

That may be why the overlap with the organic top ten varies so much by study and by date. Ahrefs found 76% of cited pages ranked in the top ten in July 2025, but only about 38% after Gemini 3 in March 2026. BrightEdge put the share from the top ten at 16.7% in September 2025. No single figure is "the" answer, which is why we measure the pages cited for your own phrases instead of assuming.

Google also says what does not matter. "There are no additional requirements to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode, nor other special optimizations necessary." It needs no special schema and no AI text files, and on llms.txt it is blunt: "Doing so will neither harm nor help your site's visibility or rankings in Google Search, as Google Search ignores them." Its hiring advice even asks whether an AEO or GEO provider's advice follows Google's own guidance. AI Mode, one of the two features in that first quote, does not count toward the first page guarantee.

Business Profile data can end up in the answer itself. In one national check of "near me seo" on September 27, 2026, Google's AI Overview named two of the three businesses in the map results, with their star ratings and review counts, and linked neither. It is a single observation, but it shows why the profile and the website have to agree.

How we do it

### What we change so you are the answer

Once the cited pages are measured, the work follows the gaps. We make sure every page you want quoted can be indexed and shown with a snippet. We rewrite or add the pages the answers draw on, with the facts, sources and plain answers the cited pages have, and the first-hand detail they lack. We line up your Business Profile, Bing Places and listings, and we build mentions on sites that already get cited for your phrases.

AI answers are not stable. Google says a page that meets every requirement may still not be indexed or served, and in SE Ranking's tests only 9.2% of AI Mode's cited URLs matched across three runs of the same searches. That is why the first page guarantee counts the AI answer on Google's results page, not AI Mode, on set dates, from your agreed market, and over the phrases where Google shows one.

### Beyond Google: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot and Gemini

Customers use other AI tools too. BrightLocal's 2026 survey found ChatGPT "used by 31% for business recommendations in the last 12 months", with Google's AI Mode at 23%. ChatGPT search launched on October 31, 2024 and sometimes uses outside search providers; Copilot runs on Bing's index; Gemini answers place questions from Google Maps.

The same work helps in each of them: pages worth citing, crawler access, listings that agree and mentions across the web. So we treat these tools as channels. OpenAI itself says placement in ChatGPT search "is not guaranteed", and none of these tools counts toward our first page guarantee: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini and AI Mode are not part of it, and only the AI answer Google shows on its results page is.

Questions

### Frequently asked questions

#### What are AI SEO services?

AI SEO services are the work that gets a business named, linked or cited in AI-written answers. At First Page SEO Guarantee that means pages worth citing, a site AI crawlers can read, a Business Profile and listings that agree with your website, and mentions on trusted sites. Google says optimizing for its generative AI features is still SEO, so the work sits on top of ordinary SEO rather than replacing it.

#### What is the difference between AIO, GEO and AEO?

They are industry terms rather than Google's own. GEO, generative engine optimization, was coined in a peer-reviewed paper presented at KDD 2024. AEO means answer engine optimization. AIO is used both for Google's AI Overviews, a Google product, and for AI optimization in general. Google names AEO and GEO in its own guide and says that, from its point of view, optimizing for generative AI search is still SEO.

#### Does the first page guarantee include ChatGPT or Perplexity?

No. The AI place in the first page guarantee is the AI answer Google shows on its own results page, when it names or links your business, counted over the phrases where Google shows one. ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini and Google's AI Mode are separate channels. The same SEO work helps in them, but they do not count toward the first page guarantee. OpenAI itself says placement in ChatGPT search is not assured.

#### Do I need an llms.txt file or special schema to appear in AI answers?

Not for Google. Google says there are no additional requirements or special optimizations for AI Overviews or AI Mode, no special schema to add, and that Google Search ignores llms.txt files, which neither help nor harm your visibility there. AI Mode itself does not count toward the first page guarantee. Structured data still helps Google understand a page and can earn rich results. What gets a page quoted is what gets it ranked: useful, original content on a site Google can index.

#### Why doesn't Google show an AI answer for every search?

Google says AI Overviews appear only when its systems judge them additive to classic Search, and that they "often don't trigger". Pew found an AI summary on 18% of the Google searches in its March 2025 study, more often for longer searches and for questions. In our own check of 12 commercial local searches in September 2026, 2 showed one. That is why the AI share is counted over the phrases where Google shows an AI answer.

#### How do you measure AI visibility?

On each milestone date we search every phrase on your list from your agreed market and record whether Google showed an AI answer and whether it named or linked your business. We add the impressions from Search Console's generative AI performance report, which reached all sites by August 31, 2026, and Bing Webmaster Tools' AI citation data. ChatGPT tags its referral visits with utm_source=chatgpt.com, so those show in your analytics too, though ChatGPT does not count toward the first page guarantee.

### See whether Google's AI names you

The free SEO audit is the first step. Enter your website and your email, and the work starts with a measurement of the pages and businesses Google's AI answers name for your searches today. Questions first? Contact us.

### The problem: a website that looks nice and does nothing

In our experience, a successful website is not about looking nice. It is about turning visitors into customers, and before that, about being found at all.

Most pages never are. Ahrefs found that 96.55% of the pages in its index get no traffic from Google, and in Advanced Web Ranking's July 2026 data the first three organic results took roughly 92% of the clicks that reached the top ten. A site that is not built to rank splits what is left.

When people do arrive, the site has to earn the next step. In Tebra's 2025 survey of 3,964 U.S. adults, 44% said a practice's website influences their choice of provider. If your website has traffic and no customers, it needs an upgrade.

Some businesses never had a real site at all. Google turned off the websites made with Business Profiles in March 2024, and their redirects ran only until June 10, 2024.

How we do it

### How we build a site to rank

Every build starts from the measurement, not from a theme:

- The structure comes from the phrase list. One page per service, and for multi-city businesses, each city gets its own page with its own content, written to stand on its own rather than as a copy.

- The words match the searches. Titles and main headings use the words people search with, as Google advises.

- Links connect the pages. Google uses links to find pages and to judge how relevant they are, so every page is linked from the pages that lead to it.

- Markup matches the page. Structured data helps Google understand a page and can earn rich results. Google does not call it a ranking boost.

- Your details are crawlable. In Whitespark's survey, a name, address and phone on your site that match your Business Profile is a map factor, and a site with no crawlable name, address and phone is on the list of negative factors.

- Speed is measured. Core Web Vitals are checked against Google's thresholds before launch, and again after.

The same pages are what Google's AI answers can draw on. Google says its generative AI features are rooted in its core ranking systems, and that a page must be indexed and able to show a snippet to be a supporting link. A site built this way serves all three places the first page guarantee measures.

How we do it

### How we build a site to convert

A ranking only matters if the visit becomes a customer. That is why the team that builds your site also runs your conversion work: we find where users leave the site, ask why, and test changes.

- One clear next step per page. Every page says what to do next and makes it easy.

- Navigation built for real use. Top and bottom toolbars, custom dynamic menus and multi-menus, so people reach the page they came for.

- Forms wired to your systems. Website-to-CRM, website-to-email and POS connections mean a lead or an order is not retyped by hand.

- Portals for the customers you have. Client, education and recruitment portals give people a place to log in, learn or apply.

Conversion rate percentages on this page would be guesses, so there are none. We measure yours instead, and our content writers write the words each page needs.

# SEO content writing services for pages that rank and persuade

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/services/content-writing/

Content writing

Our SEO content writing services give every page, post and press release a job: rank for the searches your customers make and move the reader to act. Our writers and editors plan each piece from what the page-one results already cover, then add what they miss. Content is how we earn the guaranteed rankings, part of the plan behind the first page guarantee in all three places: the organic results, Google's AI answers and the map results your pages support.

The guarantee

Your content is part of the plan behind our first page guarantee. We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, measured separately in each of the three places, after an assessment of your business. See how the first page guarantee is measured.

- Map results

- Organic results

- AI answers

### The problem: pages that say what every competitor says

Many business websites say the same things in the same order, and Google has been pushing that kind of page down. Its helpful content system became part of its core ranking systems in March 2024, and after those changes Google reported 45% less low-quality, unoriginal content in its results, by its own count. Its March 2024 spam policy update treats pages mass-produced to manipulate rankings as abuse, "no matter whether content is produced through automation, human efforts, or some combination of human and automated processes."

The upside is just as plain. Google's starter guide says content people find compelling and useful "will likely influence your website's presence in search results more than any of the other suggestions in this guide." For topics that affect people's health, finances or safety, where many practices sit, Google says its systems give even more weight to content that shows experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trust.

AI answers raise the bar again. Google tells site owners to focus on "unique, non-commodity content", and says a unique viewpoint that stands out can help. A page that repeats the other ten has nothing for an answer to quote.

Start here

### Start with the free SEO audit

The free SEO audit is where the work starts. Enter your website and your email on the free SEO audit page.

What comes after is the method. We build your phrase list, then pull the pages already on page one for each phrase and read them: the topics and questions they cover, their headings and format, how fresh they are and which sources they cite. The gaps come out of that comparison: phrases your competitors rank for and you do not, pages where you rank below all of them, and topics none of them cover well. That list becomes the writing plan. Before we sign, we tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

In the plan

### SEO content writing services in the plan

These are the content writing services the plan carries. Each piece is written to win a phrase on the list, and to be worth reading once it does.

#### Page text for every service and area

Every service you sell gets its own page, written around the searches customers make and your own expertise, because Whitespark's 2026 survey of 47 local search experts put a dedicated page for each service at the head of its local organic factors. For multi-city businesses, each city gets its own page with its own content, written to stand on its own rather than as a copy.

What you get: website content writing services for your service and area pages, with the words customers search for in the titles and main headings, as Google advises.

#### Blog posts and guides that answer real questions

Blog posts answer the questions people ask before they buy, in plain language and with the answer first. Each one links to the service page it supports, so the reading leads somewhere.

What you get: blog writing services planned from the questions page one already answers and the ones it leaves open.

#### Press releases

When your business has real news, a new location, a new service or a milestone, we write the press release that announces it.

What you get: press releases in plain words, written by the same team that writes your site, so the story and the pages agree.

#### Rewrites of the pages you already have

Some of your pages may already rank below the competitors for phrases on your list. We rewrite them to cover what the page-one pages cover and add what they lack, without copying them, which is what Google's own helpful-content questions ask for.

What you get: existing pages brought up to page-one depth, keeping the addresses they already rank on.

#### Copy that prompts action

Our writers and editors live and breathe digital content, and in every industry the goal is the same: optimized, compelling content that prompts thoughts and actions. Each page ends with a clear next step, and the words are tested with our conversion rate optimization work.

What you get: SEO copywriting services that serve the search and the sale in the same page.

How we do it

### How we plan content from page one

The plan is built from measurement, the same way our SEO is:

- Start from the results page. Google's layout for a phrase shows what searchers want: a guide, a service page, a list or a map. Sistrix found that search intent sets the layout, and the layout sets how many organic clicks exist. We write the format the phrase calls for.

- List what the ranking pages cover. Google says relevance starts with matching words, then looks for related content beyond the keyword. We record the topics, questions and examples each page-one result covers.

- Find the gaps. Semrush sorts keywords into groups such as "Missing" (your competitors rank and you do not) and "Weak" (you rank below all of them). Those groups, per phrase, are the writing plan.

- Cover it, then go past it. Google's helpful-content questions ask whether a page adds substantial value and originality instead of rewriting its sources. So "everything they did and more" means covering what page one covers and adding what it lacks: first-hand detail, a clear answer, a real example.

There is no length target. Google says there is no magical word count, minimum or maximum, so a page is as long as its topic needs.

How we do it

### How we write so people and AI answers use it

A page has two readers now: the person searching and the AI answer summarizing the results.

- Answer first. The main point sits at the top, in a sentence that can stand on its own.

- Show the evidence. In the peer-reviewed GEO study (KDD 2024), adding citations, quotations and statistics raised visibility in AI answers by 30-40% on one metric, a lab result rather than a promise.

- Structure for scanning. Microsoft says assistants can often lift question-and-answer pairs word for word into their answers. Google says there is no need to break content into tiny pieces for its AI. We use clear headings and FAQ blocks.

- Put a name on it. Google strongly encourages accurate bylines where readers expect them, and trust is the part of E-E-A-T it calls most important.

### Frequently asked questions

#### What are SEO content writing services?

SEO content writing services plan, write and edit the text a website needs to rank and to persuade: service pages, area pages, blog posts and supporting copy. At First Page SEO Guarantee each piece is planned from the pages already on page one for its phrase, written by our writers and editors, and linked into the rest of the site, as part of the plan behind the first page guarantee.

#### What types of content do you write?

Page text for your services and the areas you serve, blog posts and guides that answer the questions customers ask, and press releases when your business has real news. We also rewrite pages you already have so they cover what the page-one results cover. Every piece is written by the same team that runs your SEO, website and conversion work, so the words and the rankings plan agree.

#### How long should a page or blog post be?

As long as the topic needs, and no longer. Google says there is no magical word count target, minimum or maximum, and that it does not use the keywords meta tag at all. We look at what the page-one results cover for the phrase, cover the same ground, add what they lack, and stop. Padding a page to hit a number helps neither the reader nor the ranking.

#### How does content help with Google's AI answers?

Google says its AI features are rooted in its core ranking and quality systems, so the pages that rank well are among the ones those answers draw on. Google also asks for unique, non-commodity content and says there is no need to write in a special way for AI. In the peer-reviewed GEO study, adding citations, quotations and statistics made pages more visible in AI answers on one metric.

#### How does content connect to the first page guarantee?

Content is part of the plan behind the first page guarantee. It is how we earn the guaranteed rankings: the pages that win phrases in the organic results, feed Google's AI answers and support your Business Profile in the map results. The first page guarantee itself is about rankings: after an assessment, we guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google.

#### Can you write for dental and medical practices?

Yes, and health topics get extra scrutiny. Google gives more weight to strong experience, expertise and trust on topics that can affect people's health, and professional codes add limits: the ADA Code asks dentists to keep websites and SEO truthful, the ASPS Code bars misleading before-and-after photos, and the APA Code bars psychologists from soliciting testimonials from current therapy clients. Your own counsel or board has the final word.

# Conversion rate optimization services that turn visits into customers

URL: https://seoguarantee.com/services/conversion-rate-optimization/

Conversion rate optimization

Our conversion rate optimization services find where visitors leave your website, ask why, and test changes so more of the same traffic becomes leads and customers. We restructure the packaging, the presentation and the on-ramp where needed, with the same team that builds your site. It is part of the plan behind the first page guarantee: the guarantee measures rankings in the map results, the organic results and Google's AI answers, and conversion work turns those visits into business.

The guarantee

Conversion work is part of the plan behind our first page guarantee, which is about rankings, never sales. We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, measured separately in each of the three places, after an assessment of your business. See how the first page guarantee is measured.

- Map results

- Organic results

- AI answers

### The problem: traffic that leaves without a word

Every visitor costs something to win: the ranking work, the content, sometimes the ads. And clicks are scarce. SparkToro's 2024 study found that 58.5% of U.S. Google searches ended without a click, and that for every 1,000 searches only 360 clicks reached the open web, beyond Google's own properties and ads. Where Google shows an AI Overview, Advanced Web Ranking found that 74.3% of US desktop results pages ended without an organic click in July 2026, against 53.6% of pages without one.

So the visits you do get are worth more than they look. If your website has traffic and does not have conversions, it needs an upgrade. Visitors leave for reasons you can find: a page that buries the next step, a form that asks too much, a checkout with one step too many. Product checkouts are the hardest of them all, and the smallest changes can make the biggest difference.

So the first fix we reach for is not more traffic. It is finding where users leave your website altogether, and asking the bigger question: why.

Start here

### Start with the free SEO audit

The free SEO audit is where the work starts. Enter your website and your email on the free SEO audit page.

What comes after is the method. We build your phrase list, then pull the businesses and pages already on page one for each phrase and measure what they have, including how their pages lead a visitor to act: the offer, the next step, the form and the proof. Once you are a client, your own analytics show where your visitors leave, and the two together set the testing plan. Before we sign, we tell you in writing whether we can offer the first page guarantee, and for which market.

In the plan

### Conversion rate optimization services in the plan

These are the conversion rate optimization services the plan carries, done by the same team that builds and maintains your website.

#### Analytics: a map of where visitors leave

Before we know where we are heading, we have to know where we stand. Analytics, heat maps, session recordings and user testing build a map of your current site and show where it loses people.

What you get: website conversion rate optimization that starts from your own data, from the pages people enter on to the step where they give up.

#### Market research: what your customers value

Effective conversion work starts with knowing what your users care about. Our research digs into your customers' needs, goals and concerns, so your site speaks their language about what they truly value.

What you get: pages that answer the questions and doubts your customers actually have.

#### Conversion strategy: packaging, presentation and on-ramp

Building on the analytics and the research, we restructure, if needed, how your offer is packaged, how it is presented and how a new customer gets started, to bring more customers on board from the same amount of traffic. The strategy puts the work where it will pay off most.

What you get: a written plan of changes, each tied to the step in your funnel it is meant to fix.

#### Copy and design changes

Great ideas go nowhere without the right execution. Our writers, web designers and developers turn each idea into a page change: a clearer headline, a shorter form, a stronger next step, a checkout with fewer steps.

What you get: changes built and shipped on your site by the people who built it, with no hand-off to another vendor.

#### A/B testing

Conversion rate optimization is a steady process that earns better conversion rates month after month, and A/B testing is how you get there. We test different versions of an idea, keep the one that wins and move to the next.

What you get: landing page optimization services and page tests that decide changes by what your visitors do, not by opinion.

#### Personalization

With testing tools and dynamic web development, we tailor pages to different kinds of visitors, such as new and returning customers or people arriving from different searches. The better a page fits the person reading it, the better it converts.

What you get: pages that change what they show based on who is looking, where it helps.

How we do it

### How we find where visitors leave

The work starts with evidence, not a redesign:

- Read the funnel. We follow visitors from the page they land on to the step where they stop: a service page, a booking form, a checkout, a phone number they never tap.

- Watch real sessions. Heat maps and session recordings show where people scroll past, hesitate or rage-click. User testing shows what they expected to find.

- Ask why. Every drop gets a question and a likely answer: the offer is unclear, the form is too long, the proof is missing, the next step is hidden.

- Compare with page one. The pages ahead of you on Google are the ones your visitors can compare you with. We measure how they present the same service, so your page answers the comparison.

The output is a list of hypotheses, each tied to one step of the funnel, sorted by how much it could change and how hard it is to build.

How we do it

### How we test changes

Each hypothesis becomes a change, and each change is tested against the goal that matters: a lead, a booking or a sale.

- One idea at a time. Where traffic allows, versions run side by side so the result belongs to the change, not the season.

- Keep the winner. A version that wins becomes the page. One that loses is dropped, and what it taught goes into the next idea.

- Ship without hand-offs. Because the same team builds and maintains your website, a winning change is live on your site without a ticket to another vendor.

- Protect the rankings. Changes are made with your SEO in view.

Conversion rate percentages on this page would be guesses, so there are none. We measure yours instead, and report what each change did.

Questions

### Frequently asked questions

#### What do conversion rate optimization services include?

At First Page SEO Guarantee, they include six parts: analytics that map where visitors leave, market research into what your customers value, a conversion strategy for how your offer is packaged and presented, copy and design changes, A/B testing to decide between versions, and personalization for different kinds of visitors. The same team that builds and maintains your website does all six, so every change ships without a hand-off.

#### When does a business need CRO?

If your website has traffic and does not have conversions, it needs an upgrade. If you are falling short of your sales or lead goals, it is probably time to see whether your website is performing at its peak. Conversion work pays off most where visitors already arrive, because every lead or sale it adds comes from traffic you have already earned or paid for.

#### What is A/B testing?

A/B testing shows two versions of a page, or one part of it, to different visitors at the same time and measures which one leads more people to act. The winner becomes the page, and the next test starts from there. Conversion rate optimization is a steady process built on these tests, which is why it earns better conversion rates month after month instead of all at once.

#### How is CRO different from a website redesign?

A redesign changes everything at once and hopes the result is better. Conversion rate optimization changes one thing at a time and measures whether it helped, so you keep every gain and learn from every loss. The two work together: our website team handles redesigns when a site needs one, and the conversion work keeps improving the new site after it launches.

#### Is CRO part of the first page guarantee?

Conversion work is part of the plan behind the first page guarantee, and the guarantee itself is about rankings. After an assessment, we guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google, measured separately in each of the three places. It never promises traffic, leads, calls or sales; turning visits into customers is what the conversion work is for.

#### Can you improve the website I already have?

Yes. Conversion work starts with the site you have: its analytics, its pages and the steps where visitors stop. Our website team makes the changes on your current site, and if a test shows the site needs more than changes, we can upgrade it or build a new one. Either way, the same team builds, hosts, maintains and tests it.
